solutionSql:
SELECT (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booking_day,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS bookings
FROM shipments
WHERE booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND booked_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY booking_day;

rules.howSolved: Used the same half-open TIMESTAMPTZ bounds as the range in the c3-i3 ticket.
Applied no status filter, so cancelled shipments count.

ambiguities: "Calendar date ... in UTC" is read as booked_at AT TIME ZONE UTC cast to date, so grouping does not depend on the session time zone.
notes: Bookings at exactly 2026-02-01 00:00 UTC are excluded by the exclusive upper bound. Row counts per dataset: sample=17, nulls=7, boundary=12, precision=12. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
